entries.note: A rescan with nothing changed reads no DWG or PDF: size, modified time and online-only state from the listing match the state file.
One PDF saved again with new content: that PDF is read and nothing else, its DWG included (its fields are kept from the last read).
Nothing is written to Dropbox/Vellum/Index when nothing changed: not the manifest, not a shard, not a thumbnail, so Dropbox uploads nothing and the Duo downloads nothing.
One PDF changed: its project's shard, its new thumbnail and the manifest. Other projects' shards and every other thumbnail stay as they are.
Thumbnails are made only when a PDF or DWG is read, so once per file version.
